contract: qa/design-contract.md: concise first screen, anchored project details, restrained motion, themes, honest placeholders and manual publishing.

accessibility.evidence: Playwright verified keyboard skip-link focus and visible focus outline, functional labelled controls, OS reduced-motion suppression, working controls with unavailable local storage, and no dead placeholder links. Source and rendered review checked legible body text, theme contrast and representative-image labels. This is a focused review, not a full WCAG certification. Second pass: pointer spotlight response tested; manual pause clears card variables and stops all running animations. Seven browser checks pass. Profile update: nine browser checks pass, including mobile cross-project jumps and active aria-current tracking, plus actual theme SVG changes under system and persisted preferences.

responsive.evidence: Playwright found no horizontal overflow at 1440x900 and 390x844. Rendered screenshots inspected: full introduction and three project summaries fit desktop first screen; mobile stacks readable content and controls; diagrams remain uncropped. Refined effects preserve the existing layout and first-viewport card fit; updated desktop and mobile screenshots inspected.

loading.reason: Static local assets and scripts; no data fetch or application loading flow.

empty.evidence: Missing X, LinkedIn and CV destinations render visibly labelled soon placeholders without live links.

error.evidence: Browser storage exceptions tested; theme and motion controls still work for the current visit with no uncaught errors.

partial.evidence: GitHub remains usable alongside unavailable social and CV destinations; illustrations explicitly labelled as representative.

success.evidence: Theme and motion preferences survive reload; project links resolve to detailed sections; project assets decode successfully.

permission.reason: Public static portfolio has no authentication or permission-gated visitor workflow.

renderedEvidence.observation: Inspected desktop overview; identity, academic context, social/CV states and three complete project preview cards visible.
Inspected mobile introduction, wrapping social controls and beginning of stacked project grid; no horizontal scrolling.
Inspected dark-theme full-page capture with two-column project sections and representative visuals.
Inspected sticky wrapping navigator with active DRM-YOLO link and visible project heading after direct navigation.
